cases.description: Claims handling standard of a fictional property and motor insurer pasted from a policy document; headings, bullet and numbered lists, a step table and an authority-limits table carry facts that the collapse-then-split import merges into dropped runs.

drafts.label: Head of Claims
drafts.caption: Head of Claims is kept. Claims handling is owned by Head of Claims.

drafts.label: Claims handler
drafts.caption: Claims handler is kept. Loss registration is executed by Claims handler.

drafts.label: Policy administration system
drafts.caption: Policy administration system is kept. Policy verification checks Policy administration system.

drafts.label: Team leader
drafts.caption: Team leader is kept. Reserve review is approved by Team leader.

drafts.label: Approved engineer
drafts.caption: Approved engineer is kept. Motor assessment is executed by Approved engineer.

drafts.label: Claims surveyor
drafts.caption: Claims surveyor is kept. Property assessment is executed by Claims surveyor.

drafts.label: Loss adjuster
drafts.caption: Loss adjuster is kept. Property assessment is executed by Loss adjuster.

drafts.label: Special Investigations Unit
drafts.caption: Special Investigations Unit is kept. SIU investigation is executed by Special Investigations Unit.

drafts.label: Claim file
drafts.caption: Claim file is kept. Desktop review checks Claim file.

drafts.label: Open-source records
drafts.caption: Open-source records is kept. Desktop review checks Open-source records.

drafts.label: Industry databases
drafts.caption: Industry databases is kept. Desktop review checks Industry databases.

drafts.label: Customer
drafts.caption: Customer is kept. Recorded interview records Customer.

drafts.label: Consent
drafts.caption: Consent is kept. Recorded interview requires Consent.

drafts.label: Copy of the recording
drafts.caption: Copy of the recording is kept. Recorded interview provides Copy of the recording.

drafts.label: Highest amount
drafts.caption: Highest amount is kept. Delegated authority limits Highest amount.

drafts.label: Senior claims handler
drafts.caption: Senior claims handler is kept. Senior handler authority is held by Senior claims handler.

drafts.label: Claims team leader
drafts.caption: Claims team leader is kept. Team leader authority is held by Claims team leader.

drafts.label: Claims committee
drafts.caption: Claims committee is kept. Claims committee authority is held by Claims committee.

drafts.label: Exceptions to this standard
drafts.caption: Exceptions to this standard is kept. Claims committee authority approves Exceptions to this standard.

drafts.label: Review cycle
drafts.caption: Review cycle is kept. Document Control has Review cycle.

drafts.label: Next review
drafts.caption: Next review is kept. Document Control schedules Next review.
